description:
Update a specific Contract's Invoice Configuration

**Simplified Invoicing:** A commitment is invoiced with one of two methods, set by `contract_invoicing_method`: `progressive` (Construction Progress Invoicing) or `simplified` (Simplified Invoicing). On a `simplified` commitment every invoice stands on its own: any invoice can be edited, new schedule of values lines and approved change orders are available on every invoice, and billing for stored materials separately is not available. When the commitment has no saved configuration, the method comes from the project's default for its contract type. The method is locked once the first invoice is created on the commitment.

separate_billing_for_stored_materials.description: Whether billing for materials separately from the work complete is allowed

stored_materials_billing_method.description: Billing method applied to stored materials on this contract's invoices.

contract_invoicing_method.description: The invoicing method for the contract, either progressive or simplified

contract_id.description: Unique identifier for the contract this invoice configuration belongs to. Matches the contract_id path parameter used to retrieve or update the configuration.

project_id.description: Unique identifier for the project that owns the contract.

company_id.description: Unique identifier for the company that owns the project.

ssr_enabled.description: Whether Sliding Scale Retainage is enabled for this contract's invoices.

move_materials_to_previous_work_complete.description: True if the Project Invoice Configuration is set to move materials to previous work completed

commitment_has_invoices.description: True if there are any invoices associated with this commitment

retainage_rule_set.description: A set of rules to control how retainage is applied to invoices of a contract

contract_id.description: Integer ID for the associated Contract

name.description: The Name of the Retainage Rule Set

422.description: Unprocessable Entity. Returned when the requested change is invalid, for example when attempting to change contract_invoicing_method after invoices already exist on the commitment, or when enabling separate_billing_for_stored_materials while contract_invoicing_method is simplified.

contract_invoicing_method.description: The invoicing method for the contract. Only accepted for commitments when simplified invoicing is enabled for the project or company; otherwise the value is ignored. Locked once any invoice exists ...
